name: mobile-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol Server for Mobile Automation and Scraping (iOS, Android, Emulators, Simulators and Real Devices)
one_liner: A tool that lets AI agents directly control and test real or simulated phones — tap, swipe, read the screen — so QA and automation scripts can drive an actual phone app.
buyer: A QA lead at a mobile-app company who wants to automate manual testing across many devices without maintaining brittle Appium scripts.
business_use_cases: A mobile QA agency automates regression testing for client apps across a device farm using AI-driven test scripts instead of hand-written Appium code.
An app analytics or testing startup builds a 'test your app on 50 real devices overnight' service on top of it.
A no-code app builder integrates it so non-technical founders can describe a test in plain English and have an agent run it on a real device.

money_ideas.idea: A mobile QA-as-a-service offering: clients submit an app, agents run automated device tests overnight, billed per test run.
White-labeled test-automation setup service for app agencies who don't want to build this in-house.

steal_this: Wire it up to one real device this weekend and offer 'automated smoke tests for your app, run overnight' as a $200/month service to one local app developer.
